# Script generated by Github Copilot

set(VDV301_XSD_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}")
set(VDV301_XSD_SCHEMA_DIR "${VDV301_XSD_ROOT}")
set(VDV301_XSD_INCLUDE_DIR "${VDV301_XSD_ROOT}/include")
set(VDV301_XSD_SRC_DIR "${VDV301_XSD_ROOT}/src")
set(VDV301_XSD_GENERATOR "${VDV301_XSD_ROOT}/compiler/xsdcpp.exe")

file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${VDV301_XSD_INCLUDE_DIR}" "${VDV301_XSD_SRC_DIR}")

if(NOT EXISTS "${VDV301_XSD_GENERATOR}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "xsdcpp generator not found: ${VDV301_XSD_GENERATOR}")
endif()

file(GLOB VDV301_XSD_DEPENDENCIES
    "${VDV301_XSD_SCHEMA_DIR}/VDV301/*.xsd"
    "${VDV301_XSD_SCHEMA_DIR}/VDV301CZ/XSD/*.xsd"
)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${VDV301_XSD_DEPENDENCIES})

set(VDV301_XSD_SRCS)
set(VDV301_XSD_INCLUDE_DIRS
    "${VDV301_XSD_INCLUDE_DIR}"
)
set(VDV301_XSD_CLEAN_FILES)

function(vdv301_add_xsd_schema schema_name)
    set(options)
    set(oneValueArgs EXTERN)
    cmake_parse_arguments(ARG "${options}" "${oneValueArgs}" "" ${ARGN})

    set(schema_path "${VDV301_XSD_SCHEMA_DIR}/${schema_name}")
    get_filename_component(schema_stem "${schema_name}" NAME)
    string(REGEX REPLACE "\\.xsd$" "" schema_stem "${schema_stem}")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "[-.]" "_" generated_base "${schema_stem}")

    set(source_cpp "${VDV301_XSD_SRC_DIR}/${generated_base}.cpp")
        set(source_headers
            "${VDV301_XSD_INCLUDE_DIR}/${generated_base}.hpp"
            "${VDV301_XSD_INCLUDE_DIR}/${generated_base}_xsd.hpp"
        )

    set(need_configure_generation FALSE)
        foreach(candidate_path IN ITEMS "${source_cpp}" ${source_headers})
        if(NOT EXISTS "${candidate_path}" OR "${schema_path}" IS_NEWER_THAN "${candidate_path}")
            set(need_configure_generation TRUE)
        endif()
    endforeach()

    if(need_configure_generation)
        set(generator_command "${VDV301_XSD_GENERATOR}" "${schema_path}" -o "${VDV301_XSD_SRC_DIR}")
        if(ARG_EXTERN)
            list(APPEND generator_command -e "${ARG_EXTERN}")
        endif()

        execute_process(
            COMMAND ${generator_command}
            WORKING_DIRECTORY "${VDV301_XSD_ROOT}"
            RESULT_VARIABLE generator_result
            OUTPUT_VARIABLE generator_stdout
            ERROR_VARIABLE generator_stderr
        )

        if(NOT generator_result EQUAL 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR
                "xsdcpp generation failed for ${schema_name}\n"
                "stdout:\n${generator_stdout}\n"
                "stderr:\n${generator_stderr}"
            )
        endif()

            foreach(source_header IN LISTS source_headers)
                get_filename_component(header_name "${source_header}" NAME)
            if(EXISTS "${source_header}")
                file(REMOVE "${source_header}")
            endif()
            file(RENAME "${VDV301_XSD_SRC_DIR}/${header_name}" "${source_header}")
            endforeach()
    endif()

    list(APPEND VDV301_XSD_SRCS "${source_cpp}")
    list(APPEND VDV301_XSD_CLEAN_FILES "${source_cpp}" ${source_headers})
    # Export accumulated lists to parent scope so callers can see the results
    set(VDV301_XSD_SRCS "${VDV301_XSD_SRCS}" PARENT_SCOPE)
    set(VDV301_XSD_CLEAN_FILES "${VDV301_XSD_CLEAN_FILES}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
